# Upstream MFT test fixture

MFT is an unmodified copy of samples/MFT from
[omerbenamram/mft](https://github.com/omerbenamram/mft), pinned to commit
[dc36db7d3b83d68c0eecb75225c9955cfd7b2f2d](https://github.com/omerbenamram/mft/blob/dc36db7d3b83d68c0eecb75225c9955cfd7b2f2d/samples/MFT).

- Size: 13,402,112 bytes (13,088 records of 1,024 bytes).
- SHA-256: c78f4968345b70783fbf6573d86c4bf300295ae26ddde4033dd1037b802e13c1.
- Git blob: 70e2ad9efb695596a013b905dd21a950729fcb88.
- Upstream declares MIT/Apache-2.0 dual licensing. We use the MIT option;
  the upstream copyright and complete permission notice are in [LICENSE-MIT](LICENSE-MIT).
  No separate sample license notice was present in the pinned samples directory.

The ordinary cargo test suite reads this file offline, without raw-device access
or elevated privileges. Expected names, sizes, timestamps, parent references,
stream metadata and header counts were independently decoded from the fixture's
little-endian bytes, rather than generated by ntfs-mft. The tests exercise every
FILE record, selected known metadata, USA restoration, and corrupted/truncated
copies. The fixture itself remains unchanged.

This is a standalone MFT stream, not a complete volume image. It does not validate
boot-sector discovery, raw-volume I/O, external attribute payloads, or serial/parallel
volume scanning. The 20 non-FILE slots are rejected; all 13,068 FILE records are
expected to parse, including unused and extension records.

The fixture and its license are included in Cargo packages so packaged-source
tests remain self-contained.

## Privacy

This upstream sample is not documented as synthetic or anonymized.
It includes profile paths, browser-cache metadata, deleted-record data, and
confidential-looking filenames. Upstream licensing does not establish privacy
consent or additional rights to embedded third-party contents. An MFT can also
contain complete resident file contents and record slack.

The pinned bytes are retained unchanged for reproducible parser comparisons.
Treat extracted names and contents as potentially sensitive; avoid reproducing
them in public examples or reports. New regression fixtures should use minimal
synthetic data, following [the fixture requirements](../../../CONTRIBUTING.md#fixture-privacy-and-provenance).

## Git LFS

Run `git lfs install` and `git lfs pull` after cloning. Building and packaging
require the full fixture, not an LFS pointer.
